snippet.title: Check out the trailer for the MAG™ Interdiction Mission Pack Trailer!
snippet.description:
Featuring new armor, medals, ribbons and Trophies, the all new Interdiction missions contained in this pack feature two convoys, 128 players, 3 primary objectives, and no defender...both forces assume the role of attacker. And for the soldier the needs superior survivability, the Interdiction Mission Pack introduces reinforced heavy armor to the armory. A new call-to-arms has been issued, will you accept the challenge? 

The MAG™ Interdiction Mission Pack contains:
 
New 128-player game type "Interdiction" with three new maps (Faction Neutral)
•Iron Creek Quarry (Valor Theme)
•Lake Bayano Spur (Raven Theme)
•Sovot Motorway (SVER Theme)

New gear items: Heavy Armor (Improved)
•Raven - Heavy Ceramic Composite
•SVER - Triple Reinforced Battle Armor
•Valor - Plated Heavy Fiber

New medals, ribbons and trophies to support the new game type "Interdiction"
